records.text: Matthew Stafford turned Week 6 of 2017 against the Saints into a one-man demolition derby. 187 Sabotage points in a single game, a mark nobody has passed since 1999.
Jameis Winston's 2019 is the Sistine Chapel of sabotage: 1,367 points over one season, a masterpiece nobody has topped since 1999.

records.text: Eli Manning threw 34 incomplete passes against the Redskins in Week 15, 2007. The grass at that stadium has never felt so targeted.
Matthew Stafford threw 292 incompletions in 2012. He kept the clock operator busy and the punter employed all year.
Donovan McNabb was sacked 12 times by the Giants in Week 4, 2007. Somewhere around the eighth one it stopped being a pass rush and became a family reunion.
David Carr went down 76 times in 2002. His offensive line ran a strict open-door policy, and every pass rusher in the league RSVP'd.
Ty Detmer threw 7 interceptions to the Browns in Week 2, 2001. Their secondary left with enough souvenirs to open a gift shop.
Jameis Winston threw 30 interceptions in 2019, spreading the wealth around the league like a quarterback with a philanthropy budget.
Eli Manning handed the Vikings 3 pick sixes in Week 12, 2007. Their defense needed no playbook that day. He brought one for them.
Jameis Winston threw 7 pick sixes in 2019. By midseason, opposing defensive backs were stretching their hamstrings for the return before the snap.
Kurt Warner fumbled 6 times against the Giants in Week 1, 2003. The football spent the whole game looking for a more committed relationship.
Kerry Collins put the ball on the turf 23 times in 2001. Gravity remains undefeated, and he gave it plenty of chances.
Trevor Lawrence lost 4 fumbles to the Eagles in Week 4, 2022. Every one of them changed possession, which in this league is the entire point.
Aaron Brooks gave away 11 fumbles in 2003. Generosity on that scale usually comes with a tax receipt.
Kris Brown came up empty on 4 field goal tries against the Ravens in Week 8, 2001. The uprights filed for a restraining order.
Kris Brown came up empty on 14 field goal tries in 2001. Somewhere a holder is still spinning the laces and wondering what he did wrong.
Matt Gay failed on 3 extra points against the Falcons in Week 12, 2019. It is the kick nobody watches, and he made the whole stadium watch.
Jason Myers failed on 7 extra points in 2015, turning the most automatic play in football into a weekly suspense thriller.
The Broncos defense gave up 70 points to the Dolphins in Week 3, 2023. Tackling was optional that day, and nobody opted in.
The 2024 Panthers defense allowed 528 points over the season. Opposing offenses circled the Panthers on the calendar in permanent marker.
Rudi Johnson carried the ball 43 times against the Texans in Week 10, 2003. His coach found one play he liked and refused to apologize.
Larry Johnson logged 416 rushing attempts in 2006, more carries than a moving company in August.
Brandon Marshall caught 21 passes against the Colts in Week 14, 2009. The quarterback had one read all day, and it was him.
Michael Thomas caught 149 passes in 2019, the most reliable checkdown in the building and a two-point toll booth on every catch.
